analysis.summary: Two workers are handling reinforcing steel while wearing hard hats, high-visibility vests, and gloves. Safety eyewear is not visible. Several exposed and bent rebar ends are present near their upper bodies, but that concern is outside the permitted hazard categories.

hazards.title: Safety eyewear not visible during rebar work
